description: Robin adds an item. The new Tasks row carries a short name in the name column and the item cell keeps the wording; the existing rows keep theirs; the Log gains a line.
prompt: New item for the tracker: rewrite the upload endpoint's README — the auth section, the three curl examples, and the error table — mine, no rush.

graders.name: the new row opens with a short name of its own
the name is not the whole item cell pasted twice
the new row still carries a size
existing rows keep their name and size
Log times are this move's clock reads
